name: v17_stock_comp_sales_burden
hypothesis: High share-based compensation relative to sales can indicate dilution and lower earnings quality. Pair with customer authority and inventory efficiency instead of EPS/CFO/reversal to reduce correlation with existing actives.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * allocated_sbp_expense_total / sales, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(inventory_turnover, 126), subindustry)
notes: Matrix field with high coverage; avoids valuation/CFO/reversal stabilizers.

name: v17_unrecognized_comp_cost_burden
hypothesis: Unrecognized compensation cost for nonvested awards can represent future dilution/expense overhang. Prefer lower burden with operational efficiency.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unrecognized_compensation_cost_nonvested_awards / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(inventory_turnover, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Tests compensation overhang rather than current expense.

name: v17_special_items_abs_clean
hypothesis: Large special items, regardless of sign, often reduce earnings cleanliness. Penalize absolute special items and pair with operational efficiency.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fnd6_newa2v1300_spi) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(inventory_turnover, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Uses matrix special-items field; may be sparse but should avoid vector divide errors.

name: v17_debt_extinguishment_clean
hypothesis: Large gains/losses on debt extinguishment indicate balance-sheet events and financing stress. Penalize absolute event magnitude without using low-debt or EPS stabilizers.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(debt_extinguishment_gain_loss_value) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(inventory_turnover, 126), subindustry)
notes: Low-coverage matrix field; included as distinct debt-event mechanism.

name: v17_restructuring_expense_clean
hypothesis: Restructuring expenses may indicate disruption and lower earnings quality. Use matrix footnote field and non-earnings stabilizers.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * restructuring_expense_2 / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(inventory_turnover, 126), subindustry)
notes: Sparse but economically distinct; strict gates expected.

name: v17_doubtful_accounts_reserve_quality
hypothesis: Allowance for doubtful accounts relative to receivables is a sharper credit-quality signal than receivables/sales. It may diversify if combined with operational efficiency instead of earnings quality.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * fn_allowance_for_doubtful_accounts_receivable_a / receivable, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(inventory_turnover, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Watch correlation with LLp7PRmM receivables/sales ACTIVE.

name: v17_inventory_turnover_quality
hypothesis: High inventory turnover plus lower inventory burden can indicate operational efficiency and lower obsolescence risk. This tests an operating-cycle family with no standard quality/reversal parent.
expression: 0.55 * group_rank(ts_rank(inventory_turnover, 126), subindustry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * inventory / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: May be sector-specific; sub-universe check is critical.

name: v17_prepaid_expense_burden
hypothesis: High prepaid expenses relative to assets can reflect aggressive capitalization or working-capital pressure. Pair with operational efficiency and customer authority.
expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * prepaid_expense_total_2 / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(inventory_turnover, 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry)
notes: Matrix footnote field with decent coverage; checks whether prepaid burden is distinct from receivables/goodwill quality.
